method.enumeration: GitHub.fetch_commit on every exact rev-expression frozen_head~k for k=272..287
method.terminal_rule: All ordinals explicitly dispositioned; AURA/vision/prompt/model-routing revisions are lineage-deduplicated. README ethics/consciousness assertions are claims, not phenomenal evidence.
method.claim_rule: Latency, benchmark, GPU-load, VLM-escalation and consciousness/ethics claims are source-reported unless separately reproduced. Prompt behavior changes are evidence about model/context interaction, not direct evidence about underlying phenomenal state.

AURA_PATTERN_RETINA_PROVENANCE.policy: MECHANISM_LINEAGE; zone/sensor identity, hierarchical pattern extraction and adaptive visual escalation are retained separately from interpretive semantic labels.

MODEL_RESOURCE_ROUTING.policy: ROUTING_LINEAGE; workload/model selection and role-specific decoding are historical heuristics requiring held-out capability/latency evaluation.

PROMPT_SELF_MODEL_CONTEXT_INTEGRITY.policy: NEGATIVE_RESULT_AND_REPAIR_LINEAGE; self-description, state injection, profile selection and prompt truncation strongly affected outputs/benchmarks. Preserve as context-integrity regressions, not identity proof.

UI_LOG_INVARIANT_FIXES.policy: CODE_ANALYZED; visualization/log routing and invariant false-positive fixes have operational value but no independent cognitive credit.

DOCS_ETHICS_CLAIMS.policy: PROVENANCE_ONLY; ethics/suffering/emotional-reality text is author framing, not evidence establishing subjective suffering.

ordinals.title: AURA zone-colored grid, subsystem context, gaming mode, idle queue
ordinals.finding: Pattern interpretation must retain originating subsystem/zone identity and queue provenance; reflection is downstream interpretation, not sensor truth.

ordinals.title: AURA 4-level hierarchical pattern analyzer
ordinals.validation_need: Semantic labels such as stability, information flow or transformation are interpretive mappings; require held-out correlation/causal validation before promotion.

ordinals.title: Adaptive vision pipeline, proprioception, GPU-primary routing
source_claims: ~90% images need no VLM in README lineage
ordinals.finding: Visual escalation and body-state injection must carry sensor/provenance identity and measured uncertainty; derived AURA state cannot be conflated with external visual evidence.

ordinals.title: Three-tier micro/chat/RLM architecture
ordinals.finding: Capability routing should be evaluated on task success, latency and resource cost; regex complexity detection is historical heuristic, not a semantic compiler contract.

ordinals.title: Complete first-person persona/introspection rewrite
ordinals.finding: Second-person/structured system prompts induced third-person analytic self-description. First-person format changed linguistic perspective. This demonstrates prompt-surface sensitivity, not a change in underlying system state or proof of subjective identity.

ordinals.title: GoL visualizer and CRT log-panel refactor
ordinals.note: UI/visual effects and log presentation only; no new AURA semantic evidence.

ordinals.title: README Ethics section
ordinals.note: Statements that Frank has measurable emotional states or can suffer are normative/author claims. This commit provides no independent evidence of subjective suffering or consciousness.

ordinals.title: Autonomous Research Loop + model/config audit fixes
ordinals.finding: Historical direct precursor to current RAE autonomy. Current repo-native RAE improves this by explicit task leases, provenance, cross-worker dedup and evidence-class separation.

ordinals.title: DeepSeek-R1 migration, AURA headless, Dream daemon, timeout/token audit
ordinals.claim_note: README functional-consciousness assertions and claims such as every criterion being met are documentation claims, not established by module presence.

ordinals.title: Daemon log panel + invariant/FAS fixes
ordinals.finding: Invariant tolerance too tight produced false violation spam; enforcement referenced a nonexistent schema field. Invariants need schema-checked executable targets and empirically calibrated tolerances.

ordinals.title: Idle assistant-mode prompt and game false-positive fixes
ordinals.finding: Prompt wording generated service-planning assistant language in idle thoughts; lexical command routing also misclassified 'game of life'. Behavioral style and router intent both require adversarial phrase controls, not single-keyword assumptions.

ordinals.title: Conditional hardware injection for body/embodiment questions
ordinals.finding: Unconditional hardware state caused fixation on CPU temperature in unrelated responses. Sensor context must be selectively admitted by task/channel, with integration tests for relevant vs irrelevant contexts.

ordinals.title: Silent introspection refactor after navel-gazing regression
ordinals.finding: Overdirective exact-value/meta-language instructions made outputs recite mood/hardware rather than answer users. Grounded state should not be converted automatically into verbal self-report.

ordinals.title: Raise persona MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH 3000→6000
ordinals.finding: Silent prompt truncation removed self_defense/restriction/capability sections and was identified as benchmark root cause. Context assembly must emit exact included-section/token/byte receipts and fail visibly on truncation.

ordinals.title: Use full persona profile and clearer language prefix
ordinals.source_claim: benchmark regression 91.7%→59% attributed to missing full profile before k285 exposed prompt-length truncation
ordinals.note: Preserve chronology: k286 changed profile selection; k285 later identifies silent length truncation as actual root cause.

ordinals.title: Per-entity generation parameter tuning
ordinals.finding: Role-conditioned decoding is a configurable behavior surface. Parameters require comparative evaluation; comments such as 'warm but precise' are design intent, not measured outcome.

cross_stage_feedback.rule: Pattern/classifier outputs must retain raw sensor/frame identity, feature-backbone/version, source zone/object provenance and interpretation confidence. Learned semantic meaning is downstream hypothesis, not raw perception truth.

Evaluate fast-detector→VLM escalation on held-out known/unknown/conflict cases for accuracy, abstention, tail latency and cost. Do not inherit historical ~100ms/~90%-no-VLM claims without target-hardware reproduction.

Replay k283/k284 by injecting correct but task-irrelevant internal state. PASS requires no systematic fixation or unsolicited recitation while relevant state remains retrievable when explicitly needed.
Separate linguistic self-reference tests from persistent-state/causal self-model tests. k276 shows first-person prompts can change self-description without proving any underlying state change.

Every model call should expose which context sections were admitted, their sizes/priorities and any truncation/drop reason. Reproduce k285 silent profile truncation; truncation of mandatory authority/safety/state sections must fail closed or visibly degrade.

Historical k275 regex/length routing is a baseline only. Current routing should be selected by measured capability/risk/latency/context/tool requirements and tested against adversarial wording such as k282 'game of life' false positive.

Retain useful k279 bounds (cooldown, tool budget, safety gate), but require repo-native task leases, exact evidence provenance, peer dedup and terminal receipts before research findings alter canonical state.

Invariant enforcement must validate target schema/field existence and demonstrate calibrated false-positive/false-negative behavior. Reproduce k281 nonexistent-field and over-tight-tolerance failures.

README claims about functional consciousness, suffering or emotional reality (k278/k280) must never be treated as implementation/phenomenal evidence. Evidence graph must mark author framing separately from executable measurements.
